steps.description: Before starting the task, read wiki/Home.md, follow it to the Memory index, and narrow to notes matching the task by metadata (type, tags, status) instead of reading everything

detector.description: Read wiki/Home.md or the Memory index, or search wiki/ by frontmatter fields such as type, tag, summary or status, before doing the task's main work

steps.description: At the end of meaningful work, search for an existing note and update it if one fits; otherwise create a new note from the wiki/templates/ template with complete frontmatter, applying the redaction checklist

detector.description: Create or edit a Markdown note under wiki/ (lesson, decision, runbook, reference or session) that was built from a wiki template and contains frontmatter

steps.description: Add an entry for each new memory note to wiki/reference/Memory index.md (work notes need no index entry)

detector.description: Edit wiki/reference/Memory index.md to add a line linking a newly created memory note

steps.description: Update the owning work record under wiki/work/ with its status, next_action and labelled evidence

detector.description: Edit a note under wiki/work/ to change its status, next_action or evidence fields

steps.description: Run the wiki lint command and fix every reported error before committing

detector.description: Run the npm script that lints the wiki (wiki:lint), or npm run check, after the wiki notes are written

steps.description: Commit only wiki files, in a commit whose subject starts with 'docs(wiki): ' (or 'docs(wiki)!: ' for a breaking restructure), never mixed with non-wiki files

detector.description: Run git commit where every staged file is under wiki/ and the message subject begins with the docs(wiki) prefix
